Scored 667/1000 in the February Contest of the USA Computing Olympiad (USACO) Platinum Division. USACO Platinum is the highest division in USACO, featuring extremely challenging algorithmic problems that test advanced concepts such as tree structures, range queries, persistent data structures, dynamic programming optimizations, and graph theory at an international olympiad level.
